title: Crispy Flatbread with Spicy Pul Sauce
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired snack featuring crispy flatbread served with a spicy pul sauce. Crunchy and delicious, this snack is perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: pul
ingredients.notes: available in most Indian grocery stores

ingredients.name: biber
ingredients.notes: also known as dried red chilies

ingredients.name: saudi arabian
ingredients.notes: available in most Indian grocery stores

instructions: 2. Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
3. Meanwhile, heat the buttery in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add the biber to the pan and sauté for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
5. Add the pul to the pan and stir to combine with the biber.
6. Add the Saudi Arabian to the pan and stir to combine with the pul and biber.
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5-7 minutes, or until thickened.
8. Serve the crispy flatbread with the spicy pul sauce.
9. Garnish with additional biber if desired.
